text:
Rae (PM): Quick design sync: I'm proposing a tiny action bar on the regression-diff list so reviewers can approve, request changes, or mark flaky without opening the full detail. Idea: lightweight icons + descriptive tooltip + keyboard shortcuts. Mock: https://figma.com/file/reviewflow-inline
Theo (Design): Love the reduced clicks. UX notes: keep height compact, show only icon + accessible label, and reveal text label on hover/focus. Avoid burying the approve CTA; make it discoverable.
Kai (Frontend): Implementation thoughts: virtualized list + action bar component that reuses existing approve API. We'll need debounce for rapid bulk ops and optimistic UI with undo. Also recommend lazy-loading heavy preview when row expands.
Mira (A11y): Accessibility nits: action buttons need aria-labels ("Approve test 42", "Mark flaky test 42"). Ensure focus outline is visible on the action bar, not just the row. Announce bulk action results via aria-live and provide a keyboard-only path to open the override modal.
Omar (QA): For bulk approve, please surface any tests with regression > 1.5% and any flagged flaky tests. If any are present, show a small warning chip and require explicit confirmation. Also record who performed the bulk action and which tests were excluded/overridden.
Rae (PM): Copy proposals: primary = "Approve selected"; danger = "Request changes"; override modal title = "Approve with overrides"; button = "Approve anyway" + required short comment. Default threshold = 1.5%, admin-settable.
Theo (Design): I'll add a tiny delta chip next to score ("-2.1%"/"+0.8%") that includes a textual sign and tooltip with baseline vs candidate. For color, use purple/teal pairs not just red/green, and include icons so color isn't the only cue.
Kai (Frontend): Backend needs a run-summary endpoint that returns per-test delta, flaky flag, and long_output flag to avoid fetching full outputs. ETA for proto: 48h. Frontend prototype: 3 days after that. We'll show undo toast labeled "Actions applied (Undo)".
Mira (A11y): Keyboard shortcuts: j/k nav rows, Enter opens row actions, a = approve current, f = toggle flaky. Ensure undo is keyboard reachable and announced ("5 tests approved"). Also request role=\"list\"/\"listitem\" semantics for the list to improve screen reader navigation.
Omar (QA): Edge cases: if a test output changed since the reviewer opened the list, show "updated since you opened" and grey-out auto-approve. For flaky-marked tests, exclude from bulk approve by default; show an override checkbox in modal.
ci-bot: preview deployed -> https://preview.redwood.ai/runs/1829004327/inline-actions. Branch -> github.com/redwood/repo/pull/640
Rae (PM): Plan: Theo + Kai to ship prototype, Mira to produce a11y checklist, Omar to write test cases, I'll update the RFC and schedule demo in Friday crit. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
